annotations.summary: A filesystem on ovh-prod is above the usage threshold
annotations.description: At least one non-tmpfs filesystem crossed the threshold inside the window. Before the 2026-09-06 cleanup the root filesystem sat at 81% with 27 GB of BuildKit cache, which is one bad deploy away from a full disk: mongo refuses writes, dockerd cannot create layers. Check: df -h; docker system df; docker builder prune -af. UNIT NOTE: the OTel spec emits system.filesystem.utilization as a ratio 0..1, which is why the default target is 0.85. If the SigNoz graph for this metric shows 0..100 in this deployment, set signoz_alert_host_fs_utilization: 85 instead.
